lane_paragraph: Depth-Scaled Listric Updip Continuation & Blind-Basin Dual-Population Reallocation: replace the fixed 400 m FFT upward-continuation updip gravity crest migration of HTCADS-DualRegime with a locally depth-to-basement-scaled listric-dip 3-height (150/400/800 m) continuation crest-migration projector (per-pixel updip offset s = depth/tan(dip_eff)/100 m, dip_eff 62deg->38deg listric, clipped 1.5-11 px) gated by multi-height strike coherence, substituted into both the sharp out-of-quadrant GBDT and the first-principles Multi-Physics Conduit pillar, and allocate the 300 m submodular CELF budget as a dual population reserving a 6,000-dot concealed-basin hydro-geothermal tranche (deep basement outside 1 m LiDAR) before packing the remaining 31,654 dots with 300 m exclusion. Shared holdout evaluators, submission writer, tip/relay and ortho-LiDAR specialists reused unchanged.
executes_previous_session_roadmap_item: Extend uniform 400 m FFT upward continuation to locally depth-scaled 3D listric fault continuation (README next-session roadmap item 3, 2026-10-26).

experiments.name: DSLUP-BlindBasin

experiments.spec: EXP-B + axial strike-continuity smoothing + anisotropic tip-preserving (d>1.45 px) / flank-depleting (d>2.15 px) collar + marginal bar 0.0020.
